origin.rule: Use a snapshot row only when the actual primary completion date is on or before the snapshot date and no more than 90 days earlier; exclude rows with a results-first-posted date at that snapshot.

cohort.future_observation: Rows absent from the paired future snapshot or showing a future result date at or before the blank origin are excluded from labeled evaluation rather than treated as untimely.
cohort.selection: smallest SHA-256(NCT ID) then NCT ID among eligible origin rows
cohort.future_label: results_first_posted_date is after origin and no later than origin plus 365 days in the paired future snapshot

models.name: trial_local_logistic
models.features: phase, enrollment, arms, groups, design, masking, FDA-regulated indicators, and trial timing

models.name: sponsor_history_logistic
models.features: trial-local features plus lead-sponsor completed-trial count, timely-posting fraction, and posting-delay summary

models.name: heterogeneous_context_logistic
models.features: sponsor-history model plus facility, condition, intervention, and collaborator prior-trial context

history.prior_outcome_rule: Only prior interventional trials with actual primary completion at least 365 days before the origin are used for historical outcomes; an absent result by that completed horizon is a known untimely outcome.
history.relation_identity: Exact trimmed source names, case-folded and whitespace-normalized for matching; no cross-source entity merging.

evaluation.strata: each origin role plus pooled train-independent validation/test summaries
evaluation.coverage: eligible trials with relation rows and prior historical neighbors by entity type

stability_gate.training_rule: For each origin, fit only on labeled examples from strictly earlier origins.
stability_gate.admission: No automatic benchmark admission or graph-model escalation; review per-origin stability first.

task.escalation_rule: Do not build a graph neural model in this gate. Review sponsor-history and heterogeneous-context increments over the trial-local baseline first; a future graph-model gate requires a positive, reproducible held-out increment and separate reviewer approval.
task.admission: feasibility only; not a legal-compliance target and not benchmark admission

limitations: Results-first-posted-date is a registry publication outcome, not proof of legal reporting obligation or compliance.
AACT snapshots capture historical registry states; this feasibility gate does not infer information unavailable to a model at every real-world operational cutoff.
Exact source names are retained for relation matching; no sponsor, facility, condition, or intervention entity resolution is asserted.
The bounded cohort and selected monthly archives do not establish national representativeness or deployment readiness.
